baseline.reason: Guest Flip storage movement, validation, overlay rebind and presentation selection only. Fresh full DDraw/D3D1-7 related regression, retained core fixture/executor/compositor/network checks, strict DirectDraw builds, native sanitizer and old Flip runtime control, five actual XP surface interfaces and dual GPU base/composite pixel checks. Other guest families inherit the 247-suite 4I3 full run; host/protocol/shader/bundle and D3D8/9 unchanged.

sources.evidence: surface1_Flip: validate named member/self, rotate unnamed storage, exchange front/named storage without rotating intermediate members, update primary frontbuffer only for a primary. Implementation evidence; no fresh original HAL execution.

reference.scope: S2-51: nonprimary Flip never copies its source 1:1 into the primary retained base. Default ring rotation and named front/target exchange move handle/storage/memory/shadow/external/upload-debt together while preserving public identity, keys, palette and overlay id. Rebind affected visible overlay source/destination handles after rotation; present only a primary or a change affecting a visible overlay. Hidden/unrelated offscreen flips do not present. Self/unrelated/foreign named targets are refused before mutation; accepted storage prefixes are retained on transport presentation failure. Actual native C: 2830 checks, 512 two/three-buffer default/named flips, coupled fields, destination rebinding, stable overlay identity, primary base and invalid-target isolation; thirteen runtime mutations, sanitizer and old actual Flip with current helper definitions runtime control. XP five surface Flip interfaces on one three-buffer overlay: fifteen visible and five hidden successful flips, ten refused self/unrelated calls, one silent offscreen flip and 46 CPU shadow checks. Thirty-seven observed frames use twenty-two explicit primary background controls after queued SHOW/HIDE (these API calls are not asserted to present immediately); actual Flip frames contain no base write. Thirty-six overlay records, twenty-two uploads, 276 key restatements. Independent GPU replay verifies all 28416 retained-base pixels and all 28416 displayed-composite pixels per backend, distinguishing a stable primary base from the 16x12 overlay at (8,6). No CPU pixel reply is used. Existing 32x24 virtual mode fallback, not native mode/HAL acceptance. Seven textures, four explicit physical destructions; three known implicit guest child/storage leaks remain S2-53 and are preserved in the graph. Broad flip caps/lock/DC/format/interval policy, external descriptor-pointer semantics, arbitrary callback/thread/device-loss/ownership conversion, S2-52/53/54/55/57, games/FPS and review stages 4/5/6 remain open. D3D8/9 and host/protocol/shader/bundle unchanged.

validationRepairs: The old actual Flip function is compiled with current helper definitions and keeps the surface_from_any stub referenced by address. It then fails the real old screen/overlay/presentation assertion, rather than a compilation check.

The first XP SDK observation labels assumed SHOW/HIDE themselves present. Actual trace contained seventeen Presents for thirty-seven labels. The SDK now adds explicit background control writes after queued SHOW/HIDE; Flip frames have no base write. Production Flip code was unchanged, the accepted capture is fresh, and the earlier artifact is retained under stage4i6-first-control-present. The diagnostic shadow-check count was corrected from ten to nine per API.

The first overlay layer has z-order zero, because the existing initial maximum is minus one. The reader asserts zero, source/destination rectangles, stable overlay identity, current physical source and every deterministic upload.

Seven textures and four explicit physical destructions are intentional evidence of the already tracked implicit guest cleanup defect: three remaining child storages are not silently removed from the frozen graph. S2-53 remains open. Native mode/caps and complete lock/DC/interval/format policy are not claimed.
